cliopatria_baseline.completeness_rule: unique POLITY names, not raw temporal/spatial feature count

numeric_sources_registered: Correlates of War datasets where licensing permits
lookup_rule: polities/<stable-id>.json; events/<stable-id>.json; people/<stable-id>.json; places/<stable-id>.json; observations/<stable-id>.json; relations/<stable-id>.json
runtime_rule: Resources are lazy-loaded by stable ID and cached; the browser does not import the full historical corpus.
provenance_rule: Every externally sourced observation must retain source, date, unit/scope and confidence or uncertainty metadata.
scope_note: HISTORIX 1.0 is complete against its declared Cliopatria polity baseline. Event, person, place and quantitative coverage remains extensible and must not be represented as universally exhaustive.
